explanation: rM M h is an abbrev for the restriction map M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op on sections of the module sheaf. The theorem says this map preserves subtraction, and the proof is just the generic homomorphism law `map_sub`. That law is general logic/structure applied to the library's own definition, so it doesn't count as a Mathlib duplicate. I searched Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf.lean for `map_sub`, `map_add` and `map_zero` lemmas. I found no dedicated lemma stating that presheaf-of-modules restriction preserves subtraction.
